resources.string: Report to the developer: collect what the app knows now, to review and send

What Sleevesight knows right now, for the developer. It holds only what the app itself holds: its settings, what it received from the player, the sources and the AI service, and its diagnostics; never your API keys, and nothing else about your phone. Edit any part or leave it out, and say what you expected. Nothing is sent until you send it from your mail app, addressed to %1$s.
When you tapped, with the time zone, and the app\'s version and build.
Your settings. Never your API keys.
The track as the player reports it, what the sources found, and the insight with its citation check.
What the app did recently (its last %1$d steps), and what skip detection has learned.
The track changes recorded on this phone, with the tracks\' titles and times (the latest %1$d). Off until you turn it on, since it lists the tracks you played.
The report waits for the history, which is being read.
The report is too long to hand to a mail app (%1$d characters; at most %2$d). Leave out a part, or shorten one.
Too long to edit here. Leave it out with its switch, or edit it in your mail app.
Exactly this, as you left it above. Your mail app adds your email address as the sender.
